density.name: Density
density.purpose: Declare surface-level scale and coordinate spacing, typography, iconography, focus, loading, disabled, and breakpoint behavior before components render.

roles.use: Dense operations and data tables with efficient rhythm, readable type, clear grouping, and protected targets.
Touch-heavy mobile, high-focus review, TV-like dashboards, and distance-friendly reading.

productExamples.example: SM density increases information per viewport while preserving readable labels, focus, and target minimums.
LG density increases spacing, type rhythm, and hierarchy for touch, review, and distance contexts.

agentInstructions: Declare density at page or surface level.
Do not shrink below touch/accessibility constraints.
Change rhythm and grouping before sacrificing readability.
Do not expose public component size controls when Density owns scale.
rejectIf: Component exposes public size as an independent scale decision.
Compact mode breaks focus or touch target.
SM density reduces type below readable system roles.
Density changes only spacing but not type, icon, focus, loading, disabled, breakpoint, and control rhythm.
